description: Normalized k-mer frequencies: each distinct k-mer's count divided by the total number of overlapping k-mers. Values are in [0,1] and sum to 1. Optional acgtOnly (kPAL / Jellyfish profile: windows with a non-ACGT symbol skipped, denominator = counted windows) and canonical (jellyfish count -C counts) modes.

canonical.description: Canonical k-mers min(k-mer, reverse complement) (jellyfish count -C); implies acgtOnly

acgtOnly.description: Skip windows containing a non-ACGT symbol (Jellyfish / kPAL convention)

frequencies.description: Map from k-mer to its normalized frequency in [0,1]

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty

examples.name: Canonical with N/IUPAC ACGTNACGTAAcgtRTT k=3 (jellyfish count -C)
